text: APPROVE: The `for` loop with its nested `if`s moves into `AnnotatedArrowParameterClose`, which removes the nesting-weighted increments from `ArrowParameterRange` and takes it well under 15. The loop bounds, break conditions and `k - 1` result are unchanged, and `-1` matches the unfound case that the `close >= 0` check already handled. I couldn't see the rest of the file or run a build, so this relies on `close` being initialised to `-1` before the branch and on `IReadOnlyList<JsToken>` accepting the caller's token collection. The new method has a well-formed XML doc comment and no unused variables, so I see nothing that would trip warnings-as-errors.
